summary.text: Julie Miles is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Julie Miles was born in Concord, New Hampshire, according to Ballotpedia.
She first took office representing Hillsborough 12 on December 4, 2024.
